description: Department of Census and Statistics - Notifying that the National Consumer Price Index for the month of April, 2016 was 111.6
reasoning: This gazette content announces the National Consumer Price Index for April 2016, computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. This is a statistical announcement related to economic data and public information dissemination. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or fit any specialized categories (Types 4-9) such as land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. Therefore, it falls under Miscellaneous administrative matters.
